events.name: Hamilton (Touring)
events.info: HAMILTON is the epic saga that follows the rise of Founding Father Alexander Hamilton as he fights for honor, love, and a legacy that would shape the course of a nation. Based on Ron Chernow's acclaimed biography and set to a score that blends hip-hop, jazz, R&B, and Broadway, HAMILTON has had a profound impact on culture, politics, and education. HAMILTON features book, music, and lyrics by Lin-Manuel Miranda, direction by Thomas Kail, choreography by Andy Blankenbuehler, and musical supervision and orchestrations by Alex Lacamoire. In addition to its 11 Tony Awards®, it has won Grammy® and Olivier Awards, and the Pulitzer Prize for Drama.

events.name: Jax Symphony: Holiday Pops
events.info: Holiday Pops The holidays truly begin with the Jacksonville Symphony's treasured Holiday Pops! This spectacular tradition reunites the Symphony with star vocalists Campbell Walker Fields and Carole J. Bufford, under the baton of conductor Tim Hankewich. Joined by the Symphony Chorus and lively dancers from Douglas Anderson School of the Arts, the evening overflows with classic carols, holiday favorites and festive surprises. Bursting with cheer and seasonal magic, it's the most joyful way to kick off the most wonderful, most magical time of the year!
